title: Notifications
subtitle: Send a notification to end users' Client App and track who confirmed it.

compose.title: Compose
compose.titlePlaceholder: Short headline shown in the toast / modal
compose.allWarning: This notification will be delivered to every connected end user across the whole fleet.
compose.requireAckHint: When enabled, the notification shows a modal the user must acknowledge to dismiss, regardless of priority.
compose.toastHint: When enabled, surfaces an OS toast regardless of priority — launches the Client App even when it's closed, and lands in the Action Center while locked. When off, it only appears in the in-app list.
compose.invalidExpiresAt: Invalid expiry date — fix or clear the field before sending.

history.title: Sent history
history.empty: No notifications have been sent yet.
history.viewDetailTitle: Open detail (content + confirmations). Ctrl/⌘ click for a new tab.
history.reuseTitle: Load this content into the composer to edit and resend

recall.tooltip: Completely delete this notification (also removed from connected clients)
recall.confirmBody: This permanently deletes the notification. It disappears from the sent history and is removed from connected clients' panels at once. An OS toast that already surfaced cannot be recalled. This cannot be undone.

edit.tooltip: Edit this notification's content (body, expiry, priority, …). The audience can't be changed.
edit.expiresHint: Leave empty for no expiry. A past time hides it immediately.
edit.resetAcksHint: Enable when you materially changed the body — existing confirmations are cleared and everyone is asked to re-confirm. Leave off for typo fixes.
edit.invalidExpiresAt: Invalid expiry — fix it or leave it empty.

audience.title: Target PC confirmation
audience.empty: No target PCs could be resolved (the targeted group may have no current members, or the targeted PC isn't registered).

ack.title: Confirmation status
ack.empty: No confirmations yet for this notification.

toast.published: Sent — id {{id}}, fanned out to {{count}} subject(s)
